verdict.rationale: Receipt capture is a fair question for Clara, a corporate card and spend management platform, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions photo capture, email forwarding, receipt OCR, or automatic matching of receipts to transactions. The generic "automated expense reporting" marketing line and the transaction labeling for reconciliation are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an employee, I can snap a photo or forward an email and the platform OCRs the receipt and files it against the right transaction
